# 🔨 Shared-Bot-Utilities

Shared utilities, packages, small API wrappers for my projects.

At some point I've realized that `utils` folders from projects [@Aluerie/AluBot](<https://github.com/Aluerie/AluBot>) and [@Aluerie/IreBot](<https://github.com/Aluerie/IreBot>) were containing "same but different" files. So in a classic DRY (don't repeat yourself) principle I've decided to make this shared github package.
